title: VUA project-inspection read command v0.2
description: Read-face command word list of proposal 013 (word list frozen by the integration ruling announced 2026-09-09 alongside the 014 acceptance). Four read-only queries over the manager-registered project face: project.listProjects returns the full ProjectInspectionSnapshotV01 (discovery + per-project inspection); project.inspectProject returns one ProjectInspectionV01 for a registered path; project.environmentManagers returns the EnvironmentManagersSnapshotV01 (ALCOM/VCC manager capability face, proposal 004); project.lockStatus returns the pending-mutation marker tri-state for one path. Every query is read-only — the write path lives in schemas/project-ops/v0.2 (project.import-copy), read/write lines stay separate. Absence is honest: an unregistered path is a typed vua.project.project_not_found-style refusal carried by the application contract, never an invented entry.
